inlines.v: GLOWING, participle present tense Shining with intense heat; white with heat. 1. Burning with vehement heat. 2. Exhibiting a bright color; red; as a glowing color; glowing cheeks. 3. Ardent; vehement; animated; as glowing zeal. 4. Inflamed; as a glowing breast.
